90def qr_basis_alloc_args(first_dim, basis_fn):
91 '''
92 Generate the list of dimensions required to allocate the
93 supplied basis/diff-basis function
94
95 :param str first_dim: the variable name for the first dimension
96 :param basis_fn: dict holding details on the basis function
97 we want to allocate
98 :type basis_fn: dict containing 'shape', 'fspace' and and 'qr_var' keys
99 holding the quadrature shape, FunctionSpace and name
100 of the associated quadrature variable (as specified in the
101 Algorithm layer), respectively
102 :return: list of dimensions to use to allocate array
103 :rtype: list of strings
104
105 :raises InternalError: if an unrecognised quadrature shape is encountered.
106 :raises NotImplementedError: if a quadrature shape other than \
107 "gh_quadrature_xyoz" is supplied.
108 '''
109 const = LFRicConstants()
110 if basis_fn["shape"] not in const.VALID_QUADRATURE_SHAPES:
111 raise InternalError(
112 f"Unrecognised shape ('{basis_fn['''shape''']}') specified in "
113 f"dynamo0p3.qr_basis_alloc_args(). Should be one of: "
114 f"{const.VALID_QUADRATURE_SHAPES}")
115
116 qr_var = "_" + basis_fn["qr_var"]
117
118 # Dimensionality of the basis arrays depends on the
119 # type of quadrature...
120 # if basis_fn["shape"] == "gh_quadrature_xyz":
121 # alloc_args = [first_dim, basis_fn["fspace"].ndf_name,
122 # "np_xyz"+"_"+basis_fn["qr_var"]]
123 if basis_fn["shape"] == "gh_quadrature_xyoz":
124 alloc_args = [first_dim, basis_fn["fspace"].ndf_name,
125 "np_xy"+qr_var, "np_z"+qr_var]
126 # elif basis_fn["shape"] == "gh_quadrature_xoyoz":
127 # alloc_args = [first_dim, basis_fn["fspace"].ndf_name,
128 # "np_x"+"_"+basis_fn["qr_var"],
129 # "np_y"+"_"+basis_fn["qr_var"],
130 # "np_z"+"_"+basis_fn["qr_var"]]
131 elif basis_fn["shape"] == "gh_quadrature_face":
132 alloc_args = [first_dim, basis_fn["fspace"].ndf_name,
133 "np_xyz"+qr_var, "nfaces"+qr_var]
134 elif basis_fn["shape"] == "gh_quadrature_edge":
135 alloc_args = [first_dim, basis_fn["fspace"].ndf_name,
136 "np_xyz"+qr_var, "nedges"+qr_var]
137 else:
138 raise NotImplementedError(
139 f"Unrecognised shape '{basis_fn['''shape''']}' specified in "
140 f"dynamo0p3.qr_basis_alloc_args(). Should be one of: "
141 f"{const.VALID_QUADRATURE_SHAPES}")
142 return alloc_args

147class DynFuncDescriptor03():
148 ''' The Dynamo 0.3 API includes a function-space descriptor as
149 well as an argument descriptor which is not supported by the base
150 classes. This class captures the information specified in a
151 function-space descriptor. '''
152
153 def __init__(self, func_type):
154 self._func_type = func_type
155 if func_type.name != 'func_type':
156 raise ParseError(
157 f"In the lfric API each meta_func entry must be of type "
158 f"'func_type' but found '{func_type.name}'")
159 if len(func_type.args) < 2:
160 raise ParseError(
161 f"In the lfric API each meta_func entry must have at "
162 f"least 2 args, but found {len(func_type.args)}")
163 self._operator_names = []
164 const = LFRicConstants()
165 for idx, arg in enumerate(func_type.args):
166 if idx == 0: # first func_type arg
167 if arg.name not in const.VALID_FUNCTION_SPACE_NAMES:
168 raise ParseError(
169 f"In the dynamo0p3 API the 1st argument of a "
170 f"meta_func entry should be a valid function space "
171 f"name (one of {const.VALID_FUNCTION_SPACE_NAMES}), "
172 f"but found '{arg.name}' in '{func_type}'")
173 self._function_space_name = arg.name
174 else: # subsequent func_type args
175 if arg.name not in const.VALID_METAFUNC_NAMES:
176 raise ParseError(
177 f"In the lfric API, the 2nd argument and all "
178 f"subsequent arguments of a meta_func entry should "
179 f"be one of {const.VALID_METAFUNC_NAMES}, but found "
180 f"'{arg.name}' in '{func_type}'")
181 if arg.name in self._operator_names:
182 raise ParseError(
183 f"In the lfric API, it is an error to specify an "
184 f"operator name more than once in a meta_func entry, "
185 f"but '{arg.name}' is replicated in '{func_type}'")
186 self._operator_names.append(arg.name)
187 self._name = func_type.name
188
189 @property
190 def function_space_name(self):
191 ''' Returns the name of the descriptors function space '''
192 return self._function_space_name
193
194 @property
195 def operator_names(self):
196 ''' Returns a list of operators that are associated with this
197 descriptors function space '''
198 return self._operator_names
199
200 def __repr__(self):
201 return f"DynFuncDescriptor03({self._func_type})"
202
203 def __str__(self):
204 res = "DynFuncDescriptor03 object" + os.linesep
205 res += f" name='{self._name}'" + os.linesep
206 res += f" nargs={len(self._operator_names)+1}" + os.linesep
207 res += f" function_space_name[{0}] = '{self._function_space_name}'" \
208 + os.linesep
209 for idx, arg in enumerate(self._operator_names):
210 res += f" operator_name[{idx+1}] = '{arg}'" + \
211 os.linesep
212 return res

215class RefElementMetaData():
216 '''
217 Class responsible for parsing reference-element metadata and storing
218 the properties that a kernel requires.
219
220 :param str kernel_name: name of the Kernel that the metadata is for.
221 :param type_declns: list of fparser1 parse tree nodes representing type \
222 declaration statements
223 :type type_declns: list of :py:class:`fparser.one.typedecl_statements.Type`
224
225 :raises ParseError: if an unrecognised reference-element property is found.
226 :raises ParseError: if a duplicate reference-element property is found.
227
228 '''
229 # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
230 class Property(Enum):
231 '''
232 Enumeration of the various properties of the Reference Element
233 (that a kernel can request). The names of each of these corresponds to
234 the names that must be used in kernel metadata.
235
236 '''
237 NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES = 1
238 NORMALS_TO_VERTICAL_FACES = 2
239 NORMALS_TO_FACES = 3
240 OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES = 4
241 OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_VERTICAL_FACES = 5
242 OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_FACES = 6
243
244 def __init__(self, kernel_name, type_declns):
245 # The list of properties requested in the metadata (if any)
246 self.properties = []
247
248 re_properties = []
249 # Search the supplied list of type declarations for the one
250 # describing the reference-element properties required by the kernel.
251 for line in type_declns:
252 for entry in line.selector:
253 if entry == "reference_element_data_type":
254 # getkerneldescriptors raises a ParseError if the named
255 # element cannot be found.
256 re_properties = getkerneldescriptors(
257 kernel_name, line, var_name="meta_reference_element",
258 var_type="reference_element_data_type")
259 break
260 if re_properties:
261 # Optimisation - stop searching if we've found a type
262 # declaration for the reference-element data
263 break
264 try:
265 # The metadata entry is a declaration of a Fortran array of type
266 # reference_element_data_type. The initialisation of each member
267 # of this array is done as a Fortran structure constructor, the
268 # argument to which gives a property of the reference element.
269 for re_prop in re_properties:
270 for arg in re_prop.args:
271 self.properties.append(
272 self.Property[str(arg).upper()])
273 except KeyError as err:
274 # We found a reference-element property that we don't recognise.
275 # Sort for consistency when testing.
276 sorted_names = sorted([prop.name for prop in self.Property])
277 raise ParseError(
278 f"Unsupported reference-element property: '{arg}'. Supported "
279 f"values are: {sorted_names}") from err
280
281 # Check for duplicate properties
282 for prop in self.properties:
283 if self.properties.count(prop) > 1:
284 raise ParseError(f"Duplicate reference-element property "
285 f"found: '{prop}'.")
286
287
288class MeshProperty(Enum):
289 '''
290 Enumeration of the various properties of the mesh that a kernel may
291 require (either named in metadata or implicitly, depending on the type
292 of kernel).
293
294 '''
295 # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
296 ADJACENT_FACE = 1
297 NCELL_2D = 2
298 NCELL_2D_NO_HALOS = 3
299
300
301class MeshPropertiesMetaData():
302 '''
303 Parses any mesh-property kernel metadata and stores the properties that
304 a kernel requires.
305
306 :param str kernel_name: name of the kernel that the metadata is for.
307 :param type_declns: list of fparser1 parse tree nodes representing type \
308 declaration statements.
309 :type type_declns: list of :py:class:`fparser.one.typedecl_statements.Type`
310
311 :raises ParseError: if an unrecognised mesh property is found.
312 :raises ParseError: if a duplicate mesh property is found.
313
314 '''
315 # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
316 # The properties that may be specified in kernel metadata are a subset
317 # of the MeshProperty enumeration values.
318 supported_properties = [MeshProperty.ADJACENT_FACE]
319
320 def __init__(self, kernel_name, type_declns):
321 # The list of mesh properties requested in the metadata.
322 self.properties = []
323
324 mesh_props = []
325 # Search the supplied list of type declarations for the one
326 # describing the reference-element properties required by the kernel.
327 for line in type_declns:
328 for entry in line.selector:
329 if entry == "mesh_data_type":
330 # getkerneldescriptors raises a ParseError if the named
331 # element cannot be found.
332 mesh_props = getkerneldescriptors(
333 kernel_name, line, var_name="meta_mesh",
334 var_type="mesh_data_type")
335 break
336 if mesh_props:
337 # Optimisation - stop searching if we've found a type
338 # declaration for the mesh data
339 break
340 try:
341 # The metadata entry is a declaration of a Fortran array of type
342 # mesh_data_type. The initialisation of each member
343 # of this array is done as a Fortran structure constructor, the
344 # argument to which gives a mesh property.
345 for prop in mesh_props:
346 for arg in prop.args:
347 mesh_prop = MeshProperty[str(arg).upper()]
348 if mesh_prop not in self.supported_properties:
349 raise KeyError()
350 self.properties.append(mesh_prop)
351 except KeyError as err:
352 # We found a mesh property that we don't recognise or that
353 # is not supported.
354 supported_mesh_prop = [pr.name for pr in self.supported_properties]
355 raise ParseError(f"Unsupported mesh property in metadata: "
356 f"'{arg}'. Supported values are: "
357 f"{supported_mesh_prop}") from err
358
359 # Check for duplicate properties
360 for prop in self.properties:
361 if self.properties.count(prop) > 1:
362 raise ParseError(f"Duplicate mesh property "
363 f"found: '{prop}'.")
364
