372class LFRicMeshProperties(LFRicCollection):
373 '''
374 Holds all information on the the mesh properties required by either an
375 invoke or a kernel stub. Note that the creation of a suitable mesh
376 object is handled in the `DynMeshes` class. This class merely deals with
377 extracting the necessary properties from that object and providing them to
378 kernels.
379
380 :param node: kernel or invoke for which to manage mesh properties.
381 :type node: :py:class:`psyclone.domain.lfric.LFRicKern` or \
382 :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.LFRicInvoke`
383
384 '''
385 def __init__(self, node):
386 super().__init__(node)
387
388 # The (ordered) list of mesh properties required by this invoke or
389 # kernel stub.
390 self._properties = []
391
392 for call in self._calls_calls:
393 if call.mesh:
394 self._properties += [prop for prop in call.mesh.properties
395 if prop not in self._properties]
396 # Kernels that operate on the 'domain' need the number of columns,
397 # excluding those in the halo.
398 if call.iterates_over == "domain":
399 if MeshProperty.NCELL_2D_NO_HALOS not in self._properties:
400 self._properties.append(MeshProperty.NCELL_2D_NO_HALOS)
401 # Kernels performing CMA operations need the number of columns,
402 # including those in the halo.
403 if call.cma_operation:
404 if MeshProperty.NCELL_2D not in self._properties:
405 self._properties.append(MeshProperty.NCELL_2D)
406
407 # Store properties in symbol table
408 for prop in self._properties:
409 name_lower = prop.name.lower()
410 if prop.name in ["NCELL_2D", "NCELL_2D_NO_HALOS"]:
411 # This is an integer:
412 self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
413 name_lower, tag=name_lower)
414 else:
415 # E.g.: adjacent_face
416 self._symbol_table.find_or_create_array(
417 name_lower, 2, ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER,
418 tag=name_lower)
419
420 def kern_args(self, stub=False, var_accesses=None,
421 kern_call_arg_list=None):
422 # pylint: disable=too-many-locals, too-many-branches
423 '''
424 Provides the list of kernel arguments associated with the mesh
425 properties that the kernel requires. Optionally adds variable
426 access information if var_accesses is given.
427
428 :param bool stub: whether or not we are generating code for a \
429 kernel stub.
430 :param var_accesses: optional VariablesAccessInfo instance to store \
431 the information about variable accesses.
432 :type var_accesses: \
433 :py:class:`psyclone.core.VariablesAccessInfo`
434 :param kern_call_arg_list: an optional KernCallArgList instance \
435 used to store PSyIR representation of the arguments.
436 :type kern_call_arg_list: \
437 Optional[:py:class:`psyclone.domain.lfric.KernCallArgList`]
438
439 :returns: the kernel arguments associated with the mesh properties.
440 :rtype: list of str
441
442 :raises InternalError: if the class has been constructed for an \
443 invoke rather than a single kernel call.
444 :raises InternalError: if an unsupported mesh property is encountered.
445
446 '''
447 if not self._kernel_kernel:
448 raise InternalError(
449 "LFRicMeshProperties.kern_args() can only be called when "
450 "LFRicMeshProperties has been instantiated for a kernel "
451 "rather than an invoke.")
452
453 arg_list = []
454
455 for prop in self._properties:
456 if prop == MeshProperty.ADJACENT_FACE:
457 # Is this kernel already being passed the number of horizontal
458 # faces of the reference element?
459 has_nfaces = (
460 RefElementMetaData.Property.NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES
461 in self._kernel_kernel.reference_element.properties or
462 RefElementMetaData.Property.
463 OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES
464 in self._kernel_kernel.reference_element.properties)
465 if not has_nfaces:
466 if kern_call_arg_list:
467 sym = kern_call_arg_list.\
468 append_integer_reference("nfaces_re_h")
469 name = sym.name
470 else:
471 name = self._symbol_table.\
472 find_or_create_integer_symbol(
473 "nfaces_re_h", tag="nfaces_re_h").name
474 arg_list.append(name)
475 if var_accesses is not None:
476 var_accesses.add_access(Signature(name),
477 AccessType.READ, self._kernel_kernel)
478
479 adj_face = "adjacent_face"
480 if not stub and kern_call_arg_list:
481 # Use the functionality in kern_call_arg_list to properly
482 # declare the symbol and to create a PSyIR reference for it
483 _, cell_ref = \
484 kern_call_arg_list.cell_ref_name(var_accesses)
485 adj_face_sym = kern_call_arg_list. \
486 append_array_reference(adj_face,
487 [":", cell_ref],
488 ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER)
489 # Update the name in case there was a clash
490 adj_face = adj_face_sym.name
491 if var_accesses:
492 var_accesses.add_access(Signature(adj_face),
493 AccessType.READ, self._kernel_kernel,
494 [":", cell_ref])
495
496 if not stub:
497 adj_face = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
498 "adjacent_face").name
499 cell_name = "cell"
500 if self._kernel_kernel.is_coloured():
501 colour_name = "colour"
502 cmap_name = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
503 "cmap", root_name="cmap").name
504 adj_face += (f"(:,{cmap_name}({colour_name},"
505 f"{cell_name}))")
506 else:
507 adj_face += f"(:,{cell_name})"
508 arg_list.append(adj_face)
509
510 if var_accesses and not kern_call_arg_list:
511 # TODO #1320 Replace [1]
512 # The [1] just indicates that this variable is accessed
513 # as a rank 1 array. #1320 will improve this.
514 var_accesses.add_access(Signature(adj_face),
515 AccessType.READ, self._kernel_kernel,
516 [1])
517 else:
518 raise InternalError(
519 f"kern_args: found unsupported mesh property '{prop}' "
520 f"when generating arguments for kernel "
521 f"'{self._kernel.name}'. Only members of the MeshProperty "
522 f"Enum are permitted ({list(MeshProperty)}).")
523
524 return arg_list
525
526 def _invoke_declarations(self, parent):
527 '''
528 Creates the necessary declarations for variables needed in order to
529 provide mesh properties to a kernel call.
530
531 :param parent: node in the f2pygen AST to which to add declarations.
532 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
533
534 :raises InternalError: if this class has been instantiated for a \
535 kernel instead of an invoke.
536 :raises InternalError: if an unsupported mesh property is found.
537
538 '''
539 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
540
541 if not self._invoke_invoke:
542 raise InternalError(
543 "_invoke_declarations() cannot be called because "
544 "LFRicMeshProperties has been instantiated for a kernel and "
545 "not an invoke.")
546
547 for prop in self._properties:
548 # The DynMeshes class will have created a mesh object so we
549 # don't need to do that here.
550 if prop == MeshProperty.ADJACENT_FACE:
551 adj_face = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
552 "adjacent_face").name + "(:,:) => null()"
553 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
554 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
555 pointer=True, entity_decls=[adj_face]))
556 elif prop == MeshProperty.NCELL_2D_NO_HALOS:
557 name = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
558 "ncell_2d_no_halos",
559 tag="ncell_2d_no_halos").name
560 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
561 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
562 entity_decls=[name]))
563 elif prop == MeshProperty.NCELL_2D:
564 name = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
565 "ncell_2d", tag="ncell_2d").name
566 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
567 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
568 entity_decls=[name]))
569 else:
570 raise InternalError(
571 f"Found unsupported mesh property '{prop}' when generating"
572 f" invoke declarations. Only members of the MeshProperty "
573 f"Enum are permitted ({list(MeshProperty)}).")
574
575 def _stub_declarations(self, parent):
576 '''
577 Creates the necessary declarations for the variables needed in order
578 to provide properties of the mesh in a kernel stub.
579
580 :param parent: node in the f2pygen AST to which to add declarations.
581 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
582
583 :raises InternalError: if the class has been instantiated for an \
584 invoke and not a kernel.
585 :raises InternalError: if an unsupported mesh property is encountered.
586
587 '''
588 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
589
590 if not self._kernel_kernel:
591 raise InternalError(
592 "_stub_declarations() cannot be called because "
593 "LFRicMeshProperties has been instantiated for an invoke and "
594 "not a kernel.")
595
596 for prop in self._properties:
597 if prop == MeshProperty.ADJACENT_FACE:
598 adj_face = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_array(
599 "adjacent_face", 2, ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER,
600 tag="adjacent_face").name
601 # 'nfaces_re_h' will have been declared by the
602 # DynReferenceElement class.
603 dimension = self._symbol_table.\
604 find_or_create_integer_symbol("nfaces_re_h",
605 tag="nfaces_re_h").name
606 parent.add(
607 DeclGen(
608 parent, datatype="integer",
609 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
610 dimension=dimension,
611 intent="in", entity_decls=[adj_face]))
612 elif prop == MeshProperty.NCELL_2D:
613 ncell_2d = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
614 "ncell_2d", tag="ncell_2d")
615 parent.add(
616 DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
617 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
618 intent="in", entity_decls=[ncell_2d.name]))
619 else:
620 raise InternalError(
621 f"Found unsupported mesh property '{prop}' when generating"
622 f" declarations for kernel stub. Only members of the "
623 f"MeshProperty Enum are permitted ({list(MeshProperty)})")
624
625 def initialise(self, parent):
626 '''
627 Creates the f2pygen nodes for the initialisation of properties of
628 the mesh.
629
630 :param parent: node in the f2pygen tree to which to add statements.
631 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
632
633 :raises InternalError: if an unsupported mesh property is encountered.
634
635 '''
636 const = LFRicConstants()
637 # Since colouring is applied via transformations, we have to check for
638 # it now, rather than when this class was first constructed.
639 need_colour_limits = False
640 need_colour_halo_limits = False
641 for call in self._calls_calls:
642 if call.is_coloured() and not call.is_intergrid:
643 loop = call.parent.parent
644 # Record whether or not this coloured loop accesses the halo.
645 if loop.upper_bound_name in const.HALO_ACCESS_LOOP_BOUNDS:
646 need_colour_halo_limits = True
647 else:
648 need_colour_limits = True
649
650 if not self._properties and not (need_colour_limits or
651 need_colour_halo_limits):
652 # If no mesh properties are required and there's no colouring
653 # (which requires a mesh object to lookup loop bounds) then we
654 # need do nothing.
655 return
656
657 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
658 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, " Initialise mesh properties"))
659 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
660
661 mesh = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag("mesh").name
662
663 for prop in self._properties:
664 if prop == MeshProperty.ADJACENT_FACE:
665 adj_face = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
666 "adjacent_face").name
667 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, pointer=True, lhs=adj_face,
668 rhs=mesh+"%get_adjacent_face()"))
669
670 elif prop == MeshProperty.NCELL_2D_NO_HALOS:
671 name = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
672 "ncell_2d_no_halos", tag="ncell_2d_no_halos").name
673 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=name,
674 rhs=mesh+"%get_last_edge_cell()"))
675
676 elif prop == MeshProperty.NCELL_2D:
677 name = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
678 "ncell_2d", tag="ncell_2d").name
679 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=name,
680 rhs=mesh+"%get_ncells_2d()"))
681 else:
682 raise InternalError(
683 f"Found unsupported mesh property '{str(prop)}' when "
684 f"generating initialisation code. Only members of the "
685 f"MeshProperty Enum are permitted ({list(MeshProperty)})")
686
687 if need_colour_halo_limits:
688 lhs = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
689 "last_halo_cell_all_colours").name
690 rhs = f"{mesh}%get_last_halo_cell_all_colours()"
691 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=lhs, rhs=rhs))
692 if need_colour_limits:
693 lhs = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
694 "last_edge_cell_all_colours").name
695 rhs = f"{mesh}%get_last_edge_cell_all_colours()"
696 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=lhs, rhs=rhs))
697
698
699class DynReferenceElement(LFRicCollection):
700 '''
701 Holds all information on the properties of the Reference Element
702 required by an Invoke or a Kernel stub.
703
704 :param node: Kernel or Invoke for which to manage Reference-Element \
705 properties.
706 :type node: :py:class:`psyclone.domain.lfric.LFRicKern` or \
707 :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.LFRicInvoke`
708
709 :raises InternalError: if an unsupported reference-element property \
710 is encountered.
711
712 '''
713 # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes
714 def __init__(self, node):
715 # pylint: disable=too-many-branches, too-many-statements
716 super().__init__(node)
717
718 # Create a union of the reference-element properties required by all
719 # kernels in this invoke. Use a list to preserve the order in the
720 # kernel metadata (in the case of a kernel stub) and remove duplicate
721 # entries by using OrderedDict.
722 self._properties = []
723 self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required = False
724
725 for call in self._calls_calls:
726 if call.reference_element:
727 self._properties.extend(call.reference_element.properties)
728 if call.mesh and call.mesh.properties:
729 # If a kernel requires a property of the mesh then it will
730 # also require the number of horizontal faces of the
731 # reference element.
732 self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required = True
733
734 if not (self._properties or self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required):
735 return
736
737 if self._properties:
738 self._properties = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(self._properties))
739
740 symtab = self._symbol_table
741
742 # Create and store a name for the reference element object
743 self._ref_elem_name = \
744 symtab.find_or_create_tag("reference_element").name
745
746 # Initialise names for the properties of the reference element object:
747 # Number of horizontal/vertical/all faces,
748 self._nfaces_h_symbol = None
749 self._nfaces_v_symbol = None
750 self._nfaces_symbol = None
751 # Horizontal normals to faces,
752 self._horiz_face_normals_symbol_horiz_face_normals_symbol = None
753 self._horiz_face_out_normals_symbol_horiz_face_out_normals_symbol = None
754 # Vertical normals to faces,
755 self._vert_face_normals_symbol_vert_face_normals_symbol = None
756 self._vert_face_out_normals_symbol_vert_face_out_normals_symbol = None
757 # All normals to faces.
758 self._face_normals_symbol_face_normals_symbol = None
759 self._face_out_normals_symbol_face_out_normals_symbol = None
760
761 # Store argument properties for kernel calls and stub declarations
762 # and argument list
763 self._arg_properties = OrderedDict()
764
765 # Populate and check reference element properties
766 # Provide no. of horizontal faces if required
767 if (RefElementMetaData.Property.NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES
768 in self._properties or
769 RefElementMetaData.Property.OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES
770 in self._properties or
771 self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required):
772 self._nfaces_h_symbol = symtab.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
773 "nfaces_re_h", tag="nfaces_re_h")
774 # Provide no. of vertical faces if required
775 if (RefElementMetaData.Property.NORMALS_TO_VERTICAL_FACES
776 in self._properties or
777 RefElementMetaData.Property.OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_VERTICAL_FACES
778 in self._properties):
779 self._nfaces_v_symbol = symtab.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
780 "nfaces_re_v", tag="nfaces_re_v")
781 # Provide no. of all faces if required
782 if (RefElementMetaData.Property.NORMALS_TO_FACES
783 in self._properties or
784 RefElementMetaData.Property.OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_FACES
785 in self._properties):
786 self._nfaces_symbol = symtab.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
787 "nfaces_re", tag="nfaces_re")
788
789 # Now the arrays themselves, in the order specified in the
790 # kernel metadata (in the case of a kernel stub)
791 for prop in self._properties:
792 # Provide horizontal normals to faces
793 if prop == RefElementMetaData.Property.NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES:
794 name = "normals_to_horiz_faces"
795 self._horiz_face_normals_symbol_horiz_face_normals_symbol = \
796 symtab.find_or_create_array(name, 2,
797 ScalarType.Intrinsic.REAL,
798 tag=name)
799 if self._horiz_face_normals_symbol_horiz_face_normals_symbol not in self._arg_properties:
800 self._arg_properties[self._horiz_face_normals_symbol_horiz_face_normals_symbol] = \
801 self._nfaces_h_symbol
802 # Provide horizontal normals to "outward" faces
803 elif prop == (RefElementMetaData.Property.
804 OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_HORIZONTAL_FACES):
805 name = "out_normals_to_horiz_faces"
806 self._horiz_face_out_normals_symbol_horiz_face_out_normals_symbol = \
807 symtab.find_or_create_array(name, 2,
808 ScalarType.Intrinsic.REAL,
809 tag=name)
810 if self._horiz_face_out_normals_symbol_horiz_face_out_normals_symbol not in \
811 self._arg_properties:
812 self._arg_properties[self._horiz_face_out_normals_symbol_horiz_face_out_normals_symbol] \
813 = self._nfaces_h_symbol
814 elif prop == (RefElementMetaData.Property.
815 NORMALS_TO_VERTICAL_FACES):
816 name = "normals_to_vert_faces"
817 self._vert_face_normals_symbol_vert_face_normals_symbol = \
818 symtab.find_or_create_array(name, 2,
819 ScalarType.Intrinsic.REAL,
820 tag=name)
821 if self._vert_face_normals_symbol_vert_face_normals_symbol not in self._arg_properties:
822 self._arg_properties[self._vert_face_normals_symbol_vert_face_normals_symbol] = \
823 self._nfaces_v_symbol
824 # Provide vertical normals to "outward" faces
825 elif prop == (RefElementMetaData.Property.
826 OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_VERTICAL_FACES):
827 name = "out_normals_to_vert_faces"
828 self._vert_face_out_normals_symbol_vert_face_out_normals_symbol = \
829 symtab.find_or_create_array(name, 2,
830 ScalarType.Intrinsic.REAL,
831 tag=name)
832 if self._vert_face_out_normals_symbol_vert_face_out_normals_symbol not in \
833 self._arg_properties:
834 self._arg_properties[self._vert_face_out_normals_symbol_vert_face_out_normals_symbol] \
835 = self._nfaces_v_symbol
836 # Provide normals to all faces
837 elif prop == RefElementMetaData.Property.NORMALS_TO_FACES:
838 name = "normals_to_faces"
839 self._face_normals_symbol_face_normals_symbol = \
840 symtab.find_or_create_array(name, 2,
841 ScalarType.Intrinsic.REAL,
842 tag=name)
843 if self._face_normals_symbol_face_normals_symbol not in self._arg_properties:
844 self._arg_properties[self._face_normals_symbol_face_normals_symbol] = \
845 self._nfaces_symbol
846 # Provide vertical normals to all "outward" faces
847 elif prop == RefElementMetaData.Property.OUTWARD_NORMALS_TO_FACES:
848 name = "out_normals_to_faces"
849 self._face_out_normals_symbol_face_out_normals_symbol = \
850 symtab.find_or_create_array(name, 2,
851 ScalarType.Intrinsic.REAL,
852 tag=name)
853 if self._face_out_normals_symbol_face_out_normals_symbol not in \
854 self._arg_properties:
855 self._arg_properties[self._face_out_normals_symbol_face_out_normals_symbol] = \
856 self._nfaces_symbol
857 else:
858 all_props = [str(sprop)
859 for sprop in RefElementMetaData.Property]
860 raise InternalError(
861 f"Unsupported reference-element property ('{prop}') "
862 f"found when generating arguments for kernel "
863 f"'{self._kernel.name}'. Supported properties are: "
864 f"{all_props}")
865
866 def kern_args(self):
867 '''
868 :returns: the argument list for kernel call/stub arguments.
869 :rtype: List[str]
870
871 '''
872 argdict = self._arg_properties
873 # Remove duplicate "nfaces" by using OrderedDict
874 nfaces = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(argdict.values()))
875 kern_args = nfaces + list(argdict.keys())
876 return [sym.name for sym in kern_args]
877
878 def kern_args_symbols(self):
879 '''
880 :returns: the argument symbol list for kernel call/stub arguments.
881 :rtype: List[:py:class:`psyclone.psyir.symbols.Symbol`]
882
883 '''
884 argdict = self._arg_properties
885 # Remove duplicate "nfaces" by using OrderedDict
886 nfaces = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(argdict.values()))
887 return nfaces + list(argdict.keys())
888
889 def _invoke_declarations(self, parent):
890 '''
891 Create the necessary declarations for the variables needed in order
892 to provide properties of the reference element in a Kernel call.
893
894 :param parent: node in the f2pygen AST to which to add declarations.
895 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
896
897 '''
898 # Get the list of the required scalars
899 if self._properties:
900 # remove duplicates with an OrderedDict
901 nface_vars = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(
902 self._arg_properties.values()))
903 elif self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required:
904 # We only need the number of 'horizontal' faces
905 nface_vars = [self._nfaces_h_symbol]
906 else:
907 # No reference-element properties required
908 return
909
910 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
911 const = LFRicConstants()
912
913 refelem_type = const.REFELEMENT_TYPE_MAP["refelement"]["type"]
914 refelem_mod = const.REFELEMENT_TYPE_MAP["refelement"]["module"]
915 parent.add(UseGen(parent, name=refelem_mod, only=True,
916 funcnames=[refelem_type]))
917 parent.add(
918 TypeDeclGen(parent, pointer=True, is_class=True,
919 datatype=refelem_type,
920 entity_decls=[self._ref_elem_name + " => null()"]))
921
922 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
923 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
924 entity_decls=[var.name for var in nface_vars]))
925
926 if not self._properties:
927 # We only need the number of horizontal faces so we're done
928 return
929
930 # Declare the necessary arrays
931 array_decls = [f"{sym.name}(:,:)"
932 for sym in self._arg_properties.keys()]
933 my_kind = api_config.default_kind["real"]
934 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="real", kind=my_kind,
935 allocatable=True, entity_decls=array_decls))
936 # Ensure the necessary kind parameter is imported.
937 const_mod = const.UTILITIES_MOD_MAP["constants"]["module"]
938 const_mod_uses = self._invoke.invokes.psy.infrastructure_modules[
939 const_mod]
940 const_mod_uses.add(my_kind)
941
942 def _stub_declarations(self, parent):
943 '''
944 Create the necessary declarations for the variables needed in order
945 to provide properties of the reference element in a Kernel stub.
946
947 :param parent: node in the f2pygen AST to which to add declarations.
948 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
949
950 '''
951 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
952
953 if not (self._properties or self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required):
954 return
955
956 # Declare the necessary scalars (duplicates are ignored by parent.add)
957 scalars = list(self._arg_properties.values())
958 nfaces_h = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
959 "nfaces_re_h", tag="nfaces_re_h")
960 if self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required and nfaces_h not in scalars:
961 scalars.append(nfaces_h)
962
963 for nface in scalars:
964 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
965 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
966 intent="in", entity_decls=[nface.name]))
967
968 # Declare the necessary arrays
969 for arr, sym in self._arg_properties.items():
970 dimension = f"3,{sym.name}"
971 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="real",
972 kind=api_config.default_kind["real"],
973 intent="in", dimension=dimension,
974 entity_decls=[arr.name]))
975
976 def initialise(self, parent):
977 '''
978 Creates the f2pygen nodes representing the necessary initialisation
979 code for properties of the reference element.
980
981 :param parent: node in the f2pygen tree to which to add statements.
982 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
983
984 '''
985 if not (self._properties or self._nfaces_h_required_nfaces_h_required):
986 return
987
988 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
989 parent.add(
990 CommentGen(parent,
991 " Get the reference element and query its properties"))
992 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
993
994 mesh_obj_name = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag("mesh").name
995 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, pointer=True, lhs=self._ref_elem_name,
996 rhs=mesh_obj_name+"%get_reference_element()"))
997
998 if self._nfaces_h_symbol:
999 parent.add(
1000 AssignGen(parent, lhs=self._nfaces_h_symbol.name,
1001 rhs=self._ref_elem_name +
1002 "%get_number_horizontal_faces()"))
1003 if self._nfaces_v_symbol:
1004 parent.add(
1005 AssignGen(
1006 parent, lhs=self._nfaces_v_symbol.name,
1007 rhs=self._ref_elem_name + "%get_number_vertical_faces()"))
1008
1009 if self._nfaces_symbol:
1010 parent.add(
1011 AssignGen(
1012 parent, lhs=self._nfaces_symbol.name,
1013 rhs=self._ref_elem_name + "%get_number_faces()"))
1014
1015 if self._horiz_face_normals_symbol_horiz_face_normals_symbol:
1016 parent.add(
1017 CallGen(parent,
1018 name=f"{self._ref_elem_name}%get_normals_to_"
1019 f"horizontal_faces("
1020 f"{self._horiz_face_normals_symbol.name})"))
1021
1022 if self._horiz_face_out_normals_symbol_horiz_face_out_normals_symbol:
1023 parent.add(
1024 CallGen(
1025 parent,
1026 name=f"{self._ref_elem_name}%get_outward_normals_to_"
1027 f"horizontal_faces("
1028 f"{self._horiz_face_out_normals_symbol.name})"))
1029
1030 if self._vert_face_normals_symbol_vert_face_normals_symbol:
1031 parent.add(
1032 CallGen(parent,
1033 name=f"{self._ref_elem_name}%get_normals_to_vertical_"
1034 f"faces({self._vert_face_normals_symbol.name})"))
1035
1036 if self._vert_face_out_normals_symbol_vert_face_out_normals_symbol:
1037 parent.add(
1038 CallGen(
1039 parent,
1040 name=f"{self._ref_elem_name}%get_outward_normals_to_"
1041 f"vertical_faces"
1042 f"({self._vert_face_out_normals_symbol.name})"))
1043
1044 if self._face_normals_symbol_face_normals_symbol:
1045 parent.add(
1046 CallGen(parent,
1047 name=f"{self._ref_elem_name}%get_normals_to_faces"
1048 f"({self._face_normals_symbol.name})"))
1049
1050 if self._face_out_normals_symbol_face_out_normals_symbol:
1051 parent.add(
1052 CallGen(
1053 parent,
1054 name=f"{self._ref_elem_name}%get_outward_normals_to_"
1055 f"faces({self._face_out_normals_symbol.name})"))
1056
1057
1058class DynFunctionSpaces(LFRicCollection):
1059 '''
1060 Handles the declaration and initialisation of all function-space-related
1061 quantities required by an Invoke.
1062
1063 :param invoke: the Invoke or Kernel object.
1064 '''
1065 def __init__(self, kern_or_invoke):
1066 super().__init__(kern_or_invoke)
1067
1068 if self._invoke_invoke:
1069 self._function_spaces_function_spaces = self._invoke_invoke.unique_fss()[:]
1070 else:
1071 self._function_spaces_function_spaces = self._calls[0].arguments.unique_fss
1072
1073 self._var_list_var_list = []
1074
1075 # Loop over all unique function spaces used by our kernel(s)
1076 for function_space in self._function_spaces_function_spaces:
1077
1078 # We need ndf for a space if a kernel operates on cell-columns,
1079 # has a field or operator on that space and is not a
1080 # CMA kernel performing a matrix-matrix operation.
1081 if self._invoke_invoke and not self._dofs_only_dofs_only or \
1082 self._kernel and self._kernel.cma_operation != "matrix-matrix":
1083 self._var_list_var_list.append(function_space.ndf_name)
1084
1085 # If there is a field on this space then add undf to list
1086 # to declare later. However, if the invoke contains only
1087 # kernels that operate on dofs and distributed memory is
1088 # enabled then the number of dofs is obtained from the
1089 # field proxy and undf is not required.
1090 if self._invoke_invoke and self._invoke_invoke.field_on_space(function_space):
1091 if not (self._dofs_only_dofs_only and Config.get().distributed_memory):
1092 self._var_list_var_list.append(function_space.undf_name)
1093 elif self._kernel and \
1094 function_space.field_on_space(self._kernel.arguments):
1095 self._var_list_var_list.append(function_space.undf_name)
1096
1097 def _stub_declarations(self, parent):
1098 '''
1099 Add function-space-related declarations to a Kernel stub.
1100
1101 :param parent: the node in the f2pygen AST representing the kernel \
1102 stub to which to add declarations.
1103 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1104
1105 '''
1106 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
1107
1108 if self._var_list_var_list:
1109 # Declare ndf and undf for all function spaces
1110 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
1111 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
1112 intent="in", entity_decls=self._var_list_var_list))
1113
1114 def _invoke_declarations(self, parent):
1115 '''
1116 Add function-space-related declarations to a PSy-layer routine.
1117
1118 :param parent: the node in the f2pygen AST to which to add \
1119 declarations.
1120 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1121
1122 '''
1123 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
1124
1125 if self._var_list_var_list:
1126 # Declare ndf and undf for all function spaces
1127 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
1128 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
1129 entity_decls=self._var_list_var_list))
1130
1131 def initialise(self, parent):
1132 '''
1133 Create the code that initialises function-space quantities.
1134
1135 :param parent: the node in the f2pygen AST representing the PSy-layer \
1136 routine.
1137 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1138
1139 '''
1140 # Loop over all unique function spaces used by the kernels in
1141 # the invoke
1142 for function_space in self._function_spaces_function_spaces:
1143 # Initialise information associated with this function space.
1144 # If we have 1+ kernels that operate on cell-columns then we
1145 # will need ndf and undf. If we don't then we only need undf
1146 # (for the upper bound of the loop over dofs) if we're not
1147 # doing DM.
1148 if not (self._dofs_only_dofs_only and Config.get().distributed_memory):
1149 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
1150 parent.add(CommentGen(parent,
1151 " Initialise number of DoFs for " +
1152 function_space.mangled_name))
1153 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
1154
1155 # Find argument proxy name used to dereference the argument
1156 arg = self._invoke_invoke.arg_for_funcspace(function_space)
1157 name = arg.proxy_name_indexed
1158 # Initialise ndf for this function space.
1159 if not self._dofs_only_dofs_only:
1160 ndf_name = function_space.ndf_name
1161 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=ndf_name,
1162 rhs=name +
1163 "%" + arg.ref_name(function_space) +
1164 "%get_ndf()"))
1165 # If there is a field on this space then initialise undf
1166 # for this function space. However, if the invoke contains
1167 # only kernels that operate on dofs and distributed
1168 # memory is enabled then the number of dofs is obtained
1169 # from the field proxy and undf is not required.
1170 if not (self._dofs_only_dofs_only and Config.get().distributed_memory):
1171 if self._invoke_invoke.field_on_space(function_space):
1172 undf_name = function_space.undf_name
1173 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=undf_name,
1174 rhs=name + "%" +
1175 arg.ref_name(function_space) +
1176 "%get_undf()"))
1177
1178
1179class DynProxies(LFRicCollection):
1180 '''
1181 Handles all proxy-related declarations and initialisation. Unlike other
1182 sub-classes of LFRicCollection, we do not have to handle Kernel-stub
1183 generation since Kernels know nothing about proxies.
1184
1185 An instance of this class is instantiated for each Invoke before the
1186 PSy Layer is constructed. For each unique field or operator argument to
1187 a kernel in the Invoke it:
1188
1189 * Creates a DataSymbol for the corresponding proxy;
1190 * Creates a DataSymbol for the pointer to the data array accessed via
1191 the proxy. If the argument is a field vector then a DataSymbol is
1192 created for each component of the vector;
1193 * Tags that DataSymbol so that the correct symbol can always be looked
1194 up, irrespective of any name clashes;
1195
1196 Note that since the Fortran standard forbids (Note 12.34 in the
1197 Fortran2008 standard) aliasing of effective arguments that are written to,
1198 the set of unique kernel arguments must refer to unique memory locations
1199 or to those that are read only.
1200
1201 '''
1202 def __init__(self, node):
1203 super().__init__(node)
1204 const = LFRicConstants()
1205 real_field_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1206 argument_types=const.VALID_FIELD_NAMES,
1207 intrinsic_type=const.MAPPING_DATA_TYPES["gh_real"])
1208 int_field_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1209 argument_types=const.VALID_FIELD_NAMES,
1210 intrinsic_type=const.MAPPING_DATA_TYPES["gh_integer"])
1211 op_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1212 argument_types=const.VALID_OPERATOR_NAMES)
1213
1214 # We put precision Symbols in the Container symbol table.
1215 ctable = self._invoke.schedule.parent.symbol_table
1216
1217 for arg in real_field_args + int_field_args + op_args:
1218 # Create symbols that we will associate with the internal
1219 # data arrays of fields, field vectors and LMA operators.
1220 if arg.argument_type == "gh_columnwise_operator":
1221 # CMA operators are handled by the DynCMAOperators class.
1222 continue
1223 ctable.add_lfric_precision_symbol(arg.precision)
1224 intrinsic_type = "integer" if arg in int_field_args else "real"
1225 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING[arg.argument_type]
1226 if arg.vector_size > 1:
1227 for idx in range(1, arg.vector_size+1):
1228 # Make sure we're going to create a Symbol with a unique
1229 # name.
1230 new_name = self._symbol_table.next_available_name(
1231 f"{arg.name}_{idx}_{suffix}")
1232 tag = f"{arg.name}_{idx}:{suffix}"
1233 # The data for a field lives in a rank-1 array.
1234 self._add_symbol(new_name, tag, intrinsic_type, arg, 1)
1235 else:
1236 # Make sure we're going to create a Symbol with a unique
1237 # name (since this is hardwired into the
1238 # UnsupportedFortranType).
1239 new_name = self._symbol_table.next_available_name(
1240 f"{arg.name}_{suffix}")
1241 tag = f"{arg.name}:{suffix}"
1242 # The data for an operator lives in a rank-3 array.
1243 rank = 1 if arg not in op_args else 3
1244 self._add_symbol(new_name, tag, intrinsic_type, arg, rank)
1245
1246 def _add_symbol(self, name, tag, intrinsic_type, arg, rank):
1247 '''
1248 Creates a new DataSymbol representing either an LFRic field or
1249 operator and adds it to the SymbolTable associated with this class.
1250 The Symbol is of UnsupportedFortranType because it is a pointer
1251 to the internal data array and the PSyIR does not support pointers. The
1252 remainder of the type information is fully supplied in the
1253 `partial_datatype` property of the UnsupportedFortranType.
1254 The supplied Symbol name is assumed not to already exist in the
1255 SymbolTable (e.g. it is obtained with the `next_available_name` method
1256 of SymbolTable) because it is used in constructing the
1257 UnsupportedFortranType which must be done before the Symbol is created.
1258
1259 :param str name: the name of the new Symbol.
1260 :param str tag: the tag to associate with the new Symbol.
1261 :param str intrinsic_type: whether the Symbol represents "real" or
1262 "integer" data.
1263 :param arg: the metadata description of the associated kernel argument.
1264 :type arg: :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.DynKernelArgument`
1265 :param int rank: the rank of the array represented by the Symbol.
1266
1267 '''
1268 if intrinsic_type == "real":
1269 lfric_type = "LFRicRealScalarDataType"
1270 else:
1271 lfric_type = "LFRicIntegerScalarDataType"
1272 precision = LFRicConstants().precision_for_type(arg.data_type)
1273 array_type = ArrayType(
1274 LFRicTypes(lfric_type)(precision),
1275 [ArrayType.Extent.DEFERRED]*rank)
1276
1277 # Since the PSyIR doesn't have the pointer concept, we have
1278 # to have an UnsupportedFortranType.
1279 index_str = ",".join(rank*[":"])
1280 dtype = UnsupportedFortranType(
1281 f"{intrinsic_type}(kind={arg.precision}), pointer, "
1282 f"dimension({index_str}) :: {name} => null()",
1283 partial_datatype=array_type)
1284 try:
1285 self._symbol_table.new_symbol(name,
1286 symbol_type=DataSymbol,
1287 datatype=dtype,
1288 tag=tag)
1289 except KeyError:
1290 # The tag already exists and therefore we don't need to do
1291 # anything. This can happen if the Symbol Table has already
1292 # been populated by a previous call to this constructor. Even if
1293 # this is not the case, within a single Invoke we can have user-
1294 # supplied kernels that accept a full field-vector as argument
1295 # but also individual components of that vector might
1296 # be passed to Builtins. Therefore a clash with an
1297 # existing tag may occur which we can safely ignore.
1298 pass
1299
1300 def _invoke_declarations(self, parent):
1301 '''
1302 Insert declarations of all proxy-related quantities into the PSy layer.
1303
1304 :param parent: the node in the f2pygen AST representing the PSy- \
1305 layer routine.
1306 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1307
1308 '''
1309 const = LFRicConstants()
1310 const_mod = const.UTILITIES_MOD_MAP["constants"]["module"]
1311 table = self._symbol_table
1312
1313 # Declarations of real and integer field proxies
1314
1315 # Filter field arguments by intrinsic type
1316 real_field_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1317 argument_types=const.VALID_FIELD_NAMES,
1318 intrinsic_type=const.MAPPING_DATA_TYPES["gh_real"])
1319 int_field_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1320 argument_types=const.VALID_FIELD_NAMES,
1321 intrinsic_type=const.MAPPING_DATA_TYPES["gh_integer"])
1322
1323 # Create a field argument map that splits the (real and
1324 # integer) fields into their different datatypes for their
1325 # proxy's
1326 field_datatype_map = OrderedDict()
1327 for arg in real_field_args + int_field_args:
1328 try:
1329 field_datatype_map[
1330 (arg.proxy_data_type, arg.module_name)].append(arg)
1331 except KeyError:
1332 # This datatype has not been seen before so create a
1333 # new entry
1334 field_datatype_map[
1335 (arg.proxy_data_type, arg.module_name)] = [arg]
1336
1337 # Add the Invoke subroutine declarations for the different
1338 # field-type proxies
1339 for (fld_type, fld_mod), args in field_datatype_map.items():
1340 arg_list = [arg.proxy_declaration_name for arg in args]
1341 parent.add(TypeDeclGen(parent, datatype=fld_type,
1342 entity_decls=arg_list))
1343 (self._invoke.invokes.psy.
1344 infrastructure_modules[fld_mod].add(fld_type))
1345
1346 # Create declarations for the pointers to the internal
1347 # data arrays.
1348 for arg in args:
1349 (self._invoke.invokes.psy.infrastructure_modules[const_mod].
1350 add(arg.precision))
1351 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING[arg.argument_type]
1352 if arg.vector_size > 1:
1353 entity_names = []
1354 for idx in range(1, arg.vector_size+1):
1355 ttext = f"{arg.name}_{idx}:{suffix}"
1356 vsym = table.lookup_with_tag(ttext)
1357 entity_names.append(vsym.name)
1358 else:
1359 ttext = f"{arg.name}:{suffix}"
1360 sym = table.lookup_with_tag(ttext)
1361 entity_names = [sym.name]
1362 if entity_names:
1363 parent.add(
1364 DeclGen(
1365 parent, datatype=arg.intrinsic_type,
1366 kind=arg.precision, dimension=":",
1367 entity_decls=[f"{name} => null()" for
1368 name in entity_names],
1369 pointer=True))
1370
1371 # Declarations of LMA operator proxies
1372 op_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1373 argument_types=["gh_operator"])
1374 # Filter operators by their proxy datatype
1375 operators_datatype_map = OrderedDict()
1376 for op_arg in op_args:
1377 try:
1378 operators_datatype_map[op_arg.proxy_data_type].append(op_arg)
1379 except KeyError:
1380 # This proxy datatype has not been seen before so
1381 # create new entry
1382 operators_datatype_map[op_arg.proxy_data_type] = [op_arg]
1383 # Declare the operator proxies
1384 for operator_datatype, operators_list in \
1385 operators_datatype_map.items():
1386 operators_names = [arg.proxy_declaration_name for
1387 arg in operators_list]
1388 parent.add(TypeDeclGen(parent, datatype=operator_datatype,
1389 entity_decls=operators_names))
1390 for arg in operators_list:
1391 name = arg.name
1392 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING[arg.argument_type]
1393 ttext = f"{name}:{suffix}"
1394 sym = table.lookup_with_tag(ttext)
1395 # Declare the pointer to the stencil array.
1396 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="real",
1397 kind=arg.precision,
1398 dimension=":,:,:",
1399 entity_decls=[f"{sym.name} => null()"],
1400 pointer=True))
1401 op_mod = operators_list[0].module_name
1402 # Ensure the appropriate derived datatype will be imported.
1403 (self._invoke.invokes.psy.infrastructure_modules[op_mod].
1404 add(operator_datatype))
1405 # Ensure the appropriate kind parameter will be imported.
1406 (self._invoke.invokes.psy.infrastructure_modules[const_mod].
1407 add(arg.precision))
1408
1409 # Declarations of CMA operator proxies
1410 cma_op_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1411 argument_types=["gh_columnwise_operator"])
1412 cma_op_proxy_decs = [arg.proxy_declaration_name for
1413 arg in cma_op_args]
1414 if cma_op_proxy_decs:
1415 op_type = cma_op_args[0].proxy_data_type
1416 op_mod = cma_op_args[0].module_name
1417 parent.add(TypeDeclGen(parent,
1418 datatype=op_type,
1419 entity_decls=cma_op_proxy_decs))
1420 (self._invoke.invokes.psy.infrastructure_modules[op_mod].
1421 add(op_type))
1422
1423 def initialise(self, parent):
1424 '''
1425 Insert code into the PSy layer to initialise all necessary proxies.
1426
1427 :param parent: node in the f2pygen AST representing the PSy-layer
1428 routine.
1429 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1430
1431 :raises InternalError: if a kernel argument of an unrecognised type
1432 is encountered.
1433
1434 '''
1435 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
1436 parent.add(CommentGen(parent,
1437 " Initialise field and/or operator proxies"))
1438 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
1439 for arg in self._invoke.psy_unique_vars:
1440 # We don't have proxies for scalars
1441 if arg.is_scalar:
1442 continue
1443
1444 const = LFRicConstants()
1445 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING[arg.argument_type]
1446
1447 if arg.vector_size > 1:
1448 # the range function below returns values from
1449 # 1 to the vector size which is what we
1450 # require in our Fortran code
1451 for idx in range(1, arg.vector_size+1):
1452 parent.add(
1453 AssignGen(parent,
1454 lhs=arg.proxy_name+"("+str(idx)+")",
1455 rhs=arg.name+"("+str(idx)+")%get_proxy()"))
1456 name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(
1457 f"{arg.name}_{idx}:{suffix}").name
1458 parent.add(
1459 AssignGen(parent,
1460 lhs=name,
1461 rhs=f"{arg.proxy_name}({idx})%data",
1462 pointer=True))
1463 else:
1464 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=arg.proxy_name,
1465 rhs=arg.name+"%get_proxy()"))
1466 if arg.is_field:
1467 name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(
1468 f"{arg.name}:{suffix}").name
1469 parent.add(
1470 AssignGen(parent,
1471 lhs=name,
1472 rhs=f"{arg.proxy_name}%data",
1473 pointer=True))
1474 elif arg.is_operator:
1475 if arg.argument_type == "gh_columnwise_operator":
1476 # CMA operator arguments are handled in DynCMAOperators
1477 pass
1478 elif arg.argument_type == "gh_operator":
1479 name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(
1480 f"{arg.name}:{suffix}").name
1481 parent.add(
1482 AssignGen(parent,
1483 lhs=name,
1484 rhs=f"{arg.proxy_name}%local_stencil",
1485 pointer=True))
1486 else:
1487 raise InternalError(
1488 f"Kernel argument '{arg.name}' is a recognised "
1489 f"operator but its type ('{arg.argument_type}') is"
1490 f" not supported by DynProxies.initialise()")
1491 else:
1492 raise InternalError(
1493 f"Kernel argument '{arg.name}' of type "
1494 f"'{arg.argument_type}' not "
1495 f"handled in DynProxies.initialise()")
1496
1497
1498class DynLMAOperators(LFRicCollection):
1499 '''
1500 Handles all entities associated with Local-Matrix-Assembly Operators.
1501 '''
1502 def _stub_declarations(self, parent):
1503 '''
1504 Declare all LMA-related quantities in a Kernel stub.
1505
1506 :param parent: the f2pygen node representing the Kernel stub.
1507 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1508
1509 '''
1510 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
1511
1512 lma_args = psyGen.args_filter(
1513 self._kernel.arguments.args, arg_types=["gh_operator"])
1514 if lma_args:
1515 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
1516 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
1517 intent="in", entity_decls=["cell"]))
1518 for arg in lma_args:
1519 size = arg.name+"_ncell_3d"
1520 op_dtype = arg.intrinsic_type
1521 op_kind = arg.precision
1522 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
1523 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
1524 intent="in", entity_decls=[size]))
1525 ndf_name_to = arg.function_space_to.ndf_name
1526 ndf_name_from = arg.function_space_from.ndf_name
1527 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype=op_dtype, kind=op_kind,
1528 dimension=",".join([size, ndf_name_to,
1529 ndf_name_from]),
1530 intent=arg.intent,
1531 entity_decls=[arg.name]))
1532
1533 def _invoke_declarations(self, parent):
1534 '''
1535 Declare all LMA-related quantities in a PSy-layer routine.
1536 Note: PSy layer in LFRic does not modify the LMA operator objects.
1537 Hence, their Fortran intents are always "in" (the data updated in the
1538 kernels is only pointed to from the LMA operator object and is thus
1539 not a part of the object).
1540
1541 :param parent: the f2pygen node representing the PSy-layer routine.
1542 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1543
1544 '''
1545 # Add the Invoke subroutine argument declarations for operators
1546 op_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1547 argument_types=["gh_operator"])
1548 # Filter operators by their datatype
1549 operators_datatype_map = OrderedDict()
1550 for op_arg in op_args:
1551 try:
1552 operators_datatype_map[op_arg.data_type].append(op_arg)
1553 except KeyError:
1554 # This datatype has not been seen before so create new entry
1555 operators_datatype_map[op_arg.data_type] = [op_arg]
1556 # Declare the operators
1557 for op_datatype, op_list in operators_datatype_map.items():
1558 operators_names = [arg.declaration_name for arg in op_list]
1559 parent.add(TypeDeclGen(
1560 parent, datatype=op_datatype,
1561 entity_decls=operators_names, intent="in"))
1562 op_mod = op_list[0].module_name
1563 # Record that we will need to import this operator
1564 # datatype from the appropriate infrastructure module
1565 (self._invoke.invokes.psy.infrastructure_modules[op_mod].
1566 add(op_datatype))
1567
1568
1569class DynCMAOperators(LFRicCollection):
1570 '''
1571 Holds all information on the Column-Matrix-Assembly operators
1572 required by an Invoke or Kernel stub.
1573
1574 :param node: either an Invoke schedule or a single Kernel object.
1575 :type node: :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.DynSchedule` or \
1576 :py:class:`psyclone.domain.lfric.LFRicKern`
1577
1578 '''
1579 # The scalar parameters that must be passed along with a CMA operator
1580 # if its 'to' and 'from' spaces are the same
1581 cma_same_fs_params = ["nrow", "bandwidth", "alpha",
1582 "beta", "gamma_m", "gamma_p"]
1583 # The scalar parameters that must be passed along with a CMA operator
1584 # if its 'to' and 'from' spaces are different
1585 cma_diff_fs_params = ["nrow", "ncol", "bandwidth", "alpha",
1586 "beta", "gamma_m", "gamma_p"]
1587
1588 def __init__(self, node):
1589 super().__init__(node)
1590
1591 # Look at every kernel call and generate a set of
1592 # the unique CMA operators involved. For each one we create a
1593 # dictionary entry. The key is the name of the CMA argument in the
1594 # PSy layer and the entry is itself another dictionary containing
1595 # two entries: the first 'arg' is the CMA argument object and the
1596 # second 'params' is the list of integer variables associated with
1597 # that CMA operator. The contents of this list depend on whether
1598 # or not the to/from function spaces of the CMA operator are the
1599 # same.
1600 self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops = OrderedDict()
1601 # You can't index into an OrderedDict so we keep a separate ref
1602 # to the first CMA argument we find.
1603 self._first_cma_arg = None
1604 for call in self._calls_calls:
1605 if call.cma_operation:
1606 # Get a list of all of the CMA arguments to this call
1607 cma_args = psyGen.args_filter(
1608 call.arguments.args,
1609 arg_types=["gh_columnwise_operator"])
1610 # Create a dictionary entry for each argument that we
1611 # have not already seen
1612 for arg in cma_args:
1613 if arg.name not in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1614 if arg.function_space_to.orig_name != \
1615 arg.function_space_from.orig_name:
1616 self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[arg.name] = {
1617 "arg": arg,
1618 "params": self.cma_diff_fs_params}
1619 else:
1620 self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[arg.name] = {
1621 "arg": arg,
1622 "params": self.cma_same_fs_params}
1623 self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[arg.name]["intent"] = arg.intent
1624 self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[arg.name]["datatype"] = \
1625 arg.intrinsic_type
1626 self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[arg.name]["kind"] = arg.precision
1627 # Keep a reference to the first CMA argument
1628 if not self._first_cma_arg:
1629 self._first_cma_arg = arg
1630
1631 # Create all the necessary Symbols here so that they are available
1632 # without the need to do a 'gen'.
1633 symtab = self._symbol_table
1634 const = LFRicConstants()
1635 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING["gh_columnwise_operator"]
1636 for op_name in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1637 new_name = self._symbol_table.next_available_name(
1638 f"{op_name}_{suffix}")
1639 tag = f"{op_name}:{suffix}"
1640 arg = self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["arg"]
1641 precision = LFRicConstants().precision_for_type(arg.data_type)
1642 array_type = ArrayType(
1643 LFRicTypes("LFRicRealScalarDataType")(precision),
1644 [ArrayType.Extent.DEFERRED]*3)
1645 index_str = ",".join(3*[":"])
1646 dtype = UnsupportedFortranType(
1647 f"real(kind={arg.precision}), pointer, "
1648 f"dimension({index_str}) :: {new_name} => null()",
1649 partial_datatype=array_type)
1650 symtab.new_symbol(new_name,
1651 symbol_type=DataSymbol,
1652 datatype=dtype,
1653 tag=tag)
1654 # Now the various integer parameters of the operator.
1655 for param in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["params"]:
1656 symtab.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
1657 f"{op_name}_{param}", tag=f"{op_name}:{param}:{suffix}")
1658
1659 def initialise(self, parent):
1660 '''
1661 Generates the calls to the LFRic infrastructure that look-up
1662 the various components of each CMA operator. Adds these as
1663 children of the supplied parent node.
1664
1665 :param parent: f2pygen node representing the PSy-layer routine.
1666 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1667
1668 '''
1669 # If we have no CMA operators then we do nothing
1670 if not self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1671 return
1672
1673 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
1674 parent.add(CommentGen(parent,
1675 " Look-up information for each CMA operator"))
1676 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
1677
1678 const = LFRicConstants()
1679 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING["gh_columnwise_operator"]
1680
1681 for op_name in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1682 # First, assign a pointer to the array containing the actual
1683 # matrix.
1684 cma_name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(
1685 f"{op_name}:{suffix}").name
1686 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=cma_name, pointer=True,
1687 rhs=self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["arg"].
1688 proxy_name_indexed+"%columnwise_matrix"))
1689 # Then make copies of the related integer parameters
1690 for param in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["params"]:
1691 param_name = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
1692 f"{op_name}:{param}:{suffix}").name
1693 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=param_name,
1694 rhs=self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["arg"].
1695 proxy_name_indexed+"%"+param))
1696
1697 def _invoke_declarations(self, parent):
1698 '''
1699 Generate the necessary PSy-layer declarations for all column-wise
1700 operators and their associated parameters.
1701 Note: PSy layer in LFRic does not modify the CMA operator objects.
1702 Hence, their Fortran intents are always "in" (the data updated in the
1703 kernels is only pointed to from the column-wise operator object and is
1704 thus not a part of the object).
1705
1706 :param parent: the f2pygen node representing the PSy-layer routine.
1707 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1708
1709 '''
1710 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
1711
1712 # If we have no CMA operators then we do nothing
1713 if not self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1714 return
1715
1716 # Add the Invoke subroutine argument declarations for column-wise
1717 # operators
1718 cma_op_args = self._invoke.unique_declarations(
1719 argument_types=["gh_columnwise_operator"])
1720 # Create a list of column-wise operator names
1721 cma_op_arg_list = [arg.declaration_name for arg in cma_op_args]
1722 if cma_op_arg_list:
1723 op_type = cma_op_args[0].data_type
1724 op_mod = cma_op_args[0].module_name
1725 parent.add(TypeDeclGen(parent,
1726 datatype=op_type,
1727 entity_decls=cma_op_arg_list,
1728 intent="in"))
1729 (self._invoke.invokes.psy.infrastructure_modules[op_mod].
1730 add(op_type))
1731
1732 const = LFRicConstants()
1733 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING["gh_columnwise_operator"]
1734 for op_name in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1735 # Declare the operator matrix itself.
1736 tag_name = f"{op_name}:{suffix}"
1737 cma_name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(tag_name).name
1738 cma_dtype = self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["datatype"]
1739 cma_kind = self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["kind"]
1740 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype=cma_dtype,
1741 kind=cma_kind, pointer=True,
1742 dimension=":,:,:",
1743 entity_decls=[f"{cma_name} => null()"]))
1744 const = LFRicConstants()
1745 const_mod = const.UTILITIES_MOD_MAP["constants"]["module"]
1746 const_mod_uses = self._invoke.invokes.psy. \
1747 infrastructure_modules[const_mod]
1748 # Record that we will need to import the kind of this
1749 # cma operator from the appropriate infrastructure
1750 # module
1751 const_mod_uses.add(cma_kind)
1752
1753 # Declare the associated integer parameters
1754 param_names = []
1755 for param in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["params"]:
1756 name = f"{op_name}_{param}"
1757 tag = f"{op_name}:{param}:{suffix}"
1758 sym = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
1759 name, tag=tag)
1760 param_names.append(sym.name)
1761 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
1762 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
1763 entity_decls=param_names))
1764
1765 def _stub_declarations(self, parent):
1766 '''
1767 Generate all necessary declarations for CMA operators being passed to
1768 a Kernel stub.
1769
1770 :param parent: f2pygen node representing the Kernel stub.
1771 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.SubroutineGen`
1772
1773 '''
1774 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
1775
1776 # If we have no CMA operators then we do nothing
1777 if not self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1778 return
1779
1780 symtab = self._symbol_table
1781
1782 # CMA operators always need the current cell index and the number
1783 # of columns in the mesh
1784 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
1785 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
1786 intent="in", entity_decls=["cell", "ncell_2d"]))
1787
1788 const = LFRicConstants()
1789 suffix = const.ARG_TYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING["gh_columnwise_operator"]
1790
1791 for op_name in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops:
1792 # Declare the associated scalar arguments before the array because
1793 # some of them are used to dimension the latter (and some compilers
1794 # get upset if this ordering is not followed)
1795 _local_args = []
1796 for param in self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["params"]:
1797 param_name = symtab.find_or_create_tag(
1798 f"{op_name}:{param}:{suffix}",
1799 root_name=f"{op_name}_{param}").name
1800 _local_args.append(param_name)
1801 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
1802 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
1803 intent="in", entity_decls=_local_args))
1804 # Declare the array that holds the CMA operator
1805 bandwidth = symtab.find_or_create_tag(
1806 f"{op_name}:bandwidth:{suffix}",
1807 root_name=f"{op_name}_bandwidth").name
1808 nrow = symtab.find_or_create_tag(
1809 f"{op_name}:nrow:{suffix}",
1810 root_name=f"{op_name}_nrow").name
1811 intent = self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["intent"]
1812 op_dtype = self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["datatype"]
1813 op_kind = self._cma_ops_cma_ops_cma_ops[op_name]["kind"]
1814 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype=op_dtype, kind=op_kind,
1815 dimension=",".join([bandwidth,
1816 nrow, "ncell_2d"]),
1817 intent=intent, entity_decls=[op_name]))
1818
1819
1820class DynMeshes():
1821 '''
1822 Holds all mesh-related information (including colour maps if
1823 required). If there are no inter-grid kernels then there is only
1824 one mesh object required (when calling kernels with operates_on==domain,
1825 colouring, doing distributed memory or querying the reference element).
1826 However, kernels performing inter-grid operations require multiple mesh
1827 objects as well as mesh maps and other quantities.
1828
1829 There are two types of inter-grid operation; the first is "prolongation"
1830 where a field on a coarse mesh is mapped onto a fine mesh. The second
1831 is "restriction" where a field on a fine mesh is mapped onto a coarse
1832 mesh.
1833
1834 :param invoke: the Invoke for which to extract information on all \
1835 required inter-grid operations.
1836 :type invoke: :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.LFRicInvoke`
1837 :param unique_psy_vars: list of arguments to the PSy-layer routine.
1838 :type unique_psy_vars: list of \
1839 :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.DynKernelArgument` objects.
1840 '''
1841
1842 def __init__(self, invoke, unique_psy_vars):
1843 # List of names of unique mesh variables referenced in the Invoke
1844 self._mesh_tag_names = []
1845 # Whether or not the associated Invoke requires colourmap information
1846 self._needs_colourmap_needs_colourmap = False
1847 self._needs_colourmap_halo_needs_colourmap_halo = False
1848 # Keep a reference to the InvokeSchedule so we can check for colouring
1849 # later
1850 self._schedule = invoke.schedule
1851 self._symbol_table = self._schedule.symbol_table
1852 # Set used to generate a list of the unique mesh objects
1853 _name_set = set()
1854
1855 # Find the first non-scalar argument to this PSy layer routine. We
1856 # will use this to look-up the mesh if there are no inter-grid
1857 # kernels in this invoke.
1858 self._first_var_first_var = None
1859 for var in unique_psy_vars:
1860 if not var.is_scalar:
1861 self._first_var_first_var = var
1862 break
1863
1864 # Loop over all kernel calls in the schedule. Keep a list of
1865 # any non-intergrid kernels so that we can generate a verbose error
1866 # message if necessary.
1867 non_intergrid_kernels = []
1868 has_intergrid = False
1869 for call in self._schedule.coded_kernels():
1870
1871 if (call.reference_element.properties or call.mesh.properties or
1872 call.iterates_over == "domain" or call.cma_operation):
1873 _name_set.add("mesh")
1874
1875 if not call.is_intergrid:
1876 non_intergrid_kernels.append(call)
1877 else:
1878 has_intergrid = True
1879 # Create and store the names of the associated mesh objects
1880 _name_set.add(f"mesh_{call._intergrid_ref.fine.name}")
1881 _name_set.add(f"mesh_{call._intergrid_ref.coarse.name}")
1882
1883 # If we found a mixture of both inter-grid and non-inter-grid kernels
1884 # then we reject the invoke()
1885 if non_intergrid_kernels and has_intergrid:
1886 raise GenerationError(
1887 f"An invoke containing inter-grid kernels must contain no "
1888 f"other kernel types but kernels "
1889 f"'{''', '''.join([c.name for c in non_intergrid_kernels])}' "
1890 f"in invoke '{invoke.name}' are not inter-grid kernels.")
1891
1892 # If distributed memory is enabled then we will need at least
1893 # one mesh object if we have one or more kernels that operate
1894 # on cell-columns or are doing redundant computation for a
1895 # kernel that operates on dofs. Since the latter condition
1896 # comes about through the application of a transformation, we
1897 # don't yet know whether or not a mesh is required. Therefore,
1898 # the only solution is to assume that a mesh object is
1899 # required if distributed memory is enabled. We also require a
1900 # mesh object if any of the kernels require properties of
1901 # either the reference element or the mesh. (Colourmaps also
1902 # require a mesh object but that is handled in colourmap_init().)
1903 if not _name_set and Config.get().distributed_memory:
1904 # We didn't already have a requirement for a mesh so add one now.
1905 _name_set.add("mesh")
1906
1907 self._add_mesh_symbols(list(_name_set))
1908
1909 def _add_mesh_symbols(self, mesh_tags):
1910 '''
1911 Add DataSymbols for the supplied list of mesh names and store the
1912 corresponding list of tags.
1913
1914 A ContainerSymbol is created for the LFRic mesh module and a TypeSymbol
1915 for the mesh type. If distributed memory is enabled then a DataSymbol
1916 to hold the maximum halo depth is created for each mesh.
1917
1918 :param mesh_tags: tag names for every mesh object required.
1919 :type mesh_tags: list of str
1920
1921 '''
1922 if not mesh_tags:
1923 return
1924
1925 self._mesh_tag_names = sorted(mesh_tags)
1926
1927 # Look up the names of the module and type for the mesh object
1928 # from the LFRic constants class.
1929 const = LFRicConstants()
1930 mmod = const.MESH_TYPE_MAP["mesh"]["module"]
1931 mtype = const.MESH_TYPE_MAP["mesh"]["type"]
1932 # Create a Container symbol for the module
1933 csym = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
1934 mmod, symbol_type=ContainerSymbol)
1935 # Create a TypeSymbol for the mesh type
1936 mtype_sym = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
1937 mtype, symbol_type=DataTypeSymbol,
1938 datatype=UnresolvedType(),
1939 interface=ImportInterface(csym))
1940
1941 name_list = []
1942 for name in mesh_tags:
1943 name_list.append(self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
1944 name, symbol_type=DataSymbol, datatype=mtype_sym).name)
1945
1946 if Config.get().distributed_memory:
1947 # If distributed memory is enabled then we require a variable
1948 # holding the maximum halo depth for each mesh.
1949 for name in mesh_tags:
1950 var_name = f"max_halo_depth_{name}"
1951 self._symbol_table.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
1952 var_name, tag=var_name)
1953
1954 def colourmap_init(self):
1955 '''
1956 Sets-up information on any required colourmaps. Since colouring is
1957 applied by Transformations, this method is called as the final step
1958 of Dynamo0p3ColourTrans.apply().
1959
1960 '''
1961 # pylint: disable=too-many-locals
1962 const = LFRicConstants()
1963 non_intergrid_kern = None
1964 sym_tab = self._schedule.symbol_table
1965
1966 for call in [call for call in self._schedule.coded_kernels() if
1967 call.is_coloured()]:
1968 # Keep a record of whether or not any kernels (loops) in this
1969 # invoke have been coloured and, if so, whether the associated loop
1970 # goes into the halo.
1971 if (call.parent.parent.upper_bound_name in
1972 const.HALO_ACCESS_LOOP_BOUNDS):
1973 self._needs_colourmap_halo_needs_colourmap_halo = True
1974 else:
1975 self._needs_colourmap_needs_colourmap = True
1976
1977 if not call.is_intergrid:
1978 non_intergrid_kern = call
1979 continue
1980
1981 # This is an inter-grid kernel so look-up the names of
1982 # the colourmap variables associated with the coarse
1983 # mesh (since that determines the iteration space).
1984 carg_name = call._intergrid_ref.coarse.name
1985 # Colour map
1986 base_name = "cmap_" + carg_name
1987 colour_map = sym_tab.find_or_create_array(
1988 base_name, 2, ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER,
1989 tag=base_name)
1990 # No. of colours
1991 base_name = "ncolour_" + carg_name
1992 ncolours = sym_tab.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
1993 base_name, tag=base_name)
1994 # Array holding the last cell of a given colour.
1995 if (Config.get().distributed_memory and
1996 not call.all_updates_are_writes):
1997 # This will require a loop into the halo and so the array is
1998 # 2D (indexed by colour *and* halo depth).
1999 base_name = "last_halo_cell_all_colours_" + carg_name
2000 last_cell = self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_array(
2001 base_name, 2, ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER, tag=base_name)
2002 else:
2003 # Array holding the last edge cell of a given colour. Just 1D
2004 # as indexed by colour only.
2005 base_name = "last_edge_cell_all_colours_" + carg_name
2006 last_cell = self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_array(
2007 base_name, 1, ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER, tag=base_name)
2008 # Add these symbols into the DynInterGrid entry for this kernel
2009 call._intergrid_ref.set_colour_info(colour_map, ncolours,
2010 last_cell)
2011
2012 if non_intergrid_kern and (self._needs_colourmap_needs_colourmap or
2013 self._needs_colourmap_halo_needs_colourmap_halo):
2014 # There aren't any inter-grid kernels but we do need colourmap
2015 # information and that means we'll need a mesh object
2016 self._add_mesh_symbols(["mesh"])
2017 # This creates the colourmap information for this invoke if we
2018 # don't already have one.
2019 colour_map = non_intergrid_kern.colourmap
2020 # No. of colours
2021 ncolours = sym_tab.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
2022 "ncolour", tag="ncolour").name
2023 if self._needs_colourmap_halo_needs_colourmap_halo:
2024 sym_tab.find_or_create_array(
2025 "last_halo_cell_all_colours", 2,
2026 ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER,
2027 tag="last_halo_cell_all_colours")
2028 if self._needs_colourmap_needs_colourmap:
2029 sym_tab.find_or_create_array(
2030 "last_edge_cell_all_colours", 1,
2031 ScalarType.Intrinsic.INTEGER,
2032 tag="last_edge_cell_all_colours")
2033
2034 def declarations(self, parent):
2035 '''
2036 Declare variables specific to mesh objects.
2037
2038 :param parent: the parent node to which to add the declarations
2039 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.BaseGen`
2040
2041 '''
2042 # pylint: disable=too-many-locals, too-many-statements
2043 api_config = Config.get().api_conf("lfric")
2044 const = LFRicConstants()
2045
2046 # We'll need various typedefs from the mesh module
2047 mtype = const.MESH_TYPE_MAP["mesh"]["type"]
2048 mmod = const.MESH_TYPE_MAP["mesh"]["module"]
2049 mmap_type = const.MESH_TYPE_MAP["mesh_map"]["type"]
2050 mmap_mod = const.MESH_TYPE_MAP["mesh_map"]["module"]
2051 if self._mesh_tag_names:
2052 name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(mtype).name
2053 parent.add(UseGen(parent, name=mmod, only=True,
2054 funcnames=[name]))
2055 if self.intergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernels:
2056 parent.add(UseGen(parent, name=mmap_mod, only=True,
2057 funcnames=[mmap_type]))
2058 # Declare the mesh object(s) and associated halo depths
2059 for tag_name in self._mesh_tag_names:
2060 name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(tag_name).name
2061 parent.add(TypeDeclGen(parent, pointer=True, datatype=mtype,
2062 entity_decls=[name + " => null()"]))
2063 # For each mesh we also need the maximum halo depth.
2064 if Config.get().distributed_memory:
2065 name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(
2066 f"max_halo_depth_{tag_name}").name
2067 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2068 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2069 entity_decls=[name]))
2070
2071 # Declare the inter-mesh map(s) and cell map(s)
2072 for kern in self.intergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernels:
2073 parent.add(TypeDeclGen(parent, pointer=True,
2074 datatype=mmap_type,
2075 entity_decls=[kern.mmap + " => null()"]))
2076 parent.add(
2077 DeclGen(parent, pointer=True, datatype="integer",
2078 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2079 entity_decls=[kern.cell_map + "(:,:,:) => null()"]))
2080
2081 # Declare the number of cells in the fine mesh and how many fine
2082 # cells there are per coarse cell
2083 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2084 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2085 entity_decls=[kern.ncell_fine,
2086 kern.ncellpercellx,
2087 kern.ncellpercelly]))
2088 # Declare variables to hold the colourmap information if required
2089 if kern.colourmap_symbol:
2090 parent.add(
2091 DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2092 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2093 pointer=True,
2094 entity_decls=[kern.colourmap_symbol.name+"(:,:)"]))
2095 parent.add(
2096 DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2097 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2098 entity_decls=[kern.ncolours_var_symbol.name]))
2099 # The cell-count array is 2D if we go into the halo and 1D
2100 # otherwise (i.e. no DM or this kernel is GH_WRITE only and
2101 # does not access the halo).
2102 dim_list = len(kern.last_cell_var_symbol.datatype.shape)*":"
2103 decln = (f"{kern.last_cell_var_symbol.name}("
2104 f"{','.join(dim_list)})")
2105 parent.add(
2106 DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer", allocatable=True,
2107 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2108 entity_decls=[decln]))
2109
2110 if not self.intergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernels and (self._needs_colourmap_needs_colourmap or
2111 self._needs_colourmap_halo_needs_colourmap_halo):
2112 # There aren't any inter-grid kernels but we do need
2113 # colourmap information
2114 base_name = "cmap"
2115 csym = self._schedule.symbol_table.lookup_with_tag("cmap")
2116 colour_map = csym.name
2117 # No. of colours
2118 base_name = "ncolour"
2119 ncolours = \
2120 self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(base_name).name
2121 # Add declarations for these variables
2122 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2123 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2124 pointer=True,
2125 entity_decls=[colour_map+"(:,:)"]))
2126 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2127 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2128 entity_decls=[ncolours]))
2129 if self._needs_colourmap_halo_needs_colourmap_halo:
2130 last_cell = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
2131 "last_halo_cell_all_colours")
2132 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2133 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2134 allocatable=True,
2135 entity_decls=[last_cell.name+"(:,:)"]))
2136 if self._needs_colourmap_needs_colourmap:
2137 last_cell = self._symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
2138 "last_edge_cell_all_colours")
2139 parent.add(DeclGen(parent, datatype="integer",
2140 kind=api_config.default_kind["integer"],
2141 allocatable=True,
2142 entity_decls=[last_cell.name+"(:)"]))
2143
2144 def initialise(self, parent):
2145 '''
2146 Initialise parameters specific to inter-grid kernels.
2147
2148 :param parent: the parent node to which to add the initialisations.
2149 :type parent: :py:class:`psyclone.f2pygen.BaseGen`
2150
2151 '''
2152 # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
2153 # If we haven't got any need for a mesh in this invoke then we
2154 # don't do anything
2155 if not self._mesh_tag_names:
2156 return
2157
2158 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
2159
2160 if len(self._mesh_tag_names) == 1:
2161 # We only require one mesh object which means that this invoke
2162 # contains no inter-grid kernels (which would require at least 2)
2163 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, " Create a mesh object"))
2164 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
2165 rhs = "%".join([self._first_var_first_var.proxy_name_indexed,
2166 self._first_var_first_var.ref_name(), "get_mesh()"])
2167 mesh_name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(
2168 self._mesh_tag_names[0]).name
2169 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, pointer=True, lhs=mesh_name, rhs=rhs))
2170 if Config.get().distributed_memory:
2171 # If distributed memory is enabled then we need the maximum
2172 # halo depth.
2173 depth_name = self._symbol_table.lookup_with_tag(
2174 f"max_halo_depth_{self._mesh_tag_names[0]}").name
2175 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=depth_name,
2176 rhs=f"{mesh_name}%get_halo_depth()"))
2177 if self._needs_colourmap_needs_colourmap or self._needs_colourmap_halo_needs_colourmap_halo:
2178 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
2179 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, " Get the colourmap"))
2180 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
2181 # Look-up variable names for colourmap and number of colours
2182 colour_map = self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
2183 "cmap").name
2184 ncolour = \
2185 self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_tag("ncolour")\
2186 .name
2187 # Get the number of colours
2188 parent.add(AssignGen(
2189 parent, lhs=ncolour, rhs=f"{mesh_name}%get_ncolours()"))
2190 # Get the colour map
2191 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, pointer=True, lhs=colour_map,
2192 rhs=f"{mesh_name}%get_colour_map()"))
2193 return
2194
2195 parent.add(CommentGen(
2196 parent,
2197 " Look-up mesh objects and loop limits for inter-grid kernels"))
2198 parent.add(CommentGen(parent, ""))
2199
2200 # Keep a list of quantities that we've already initialised so
2201 # that we don't generate duplicate assignments
2202 initialised = []
2203
2204 # Loop over the DynInterGrid objects
2205 for dig in self.intergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernelsintergrid_kernels:
2206 # We need pointers to both the coarse and the fine mesh as well
2207 # as the maximum halo depth for each.
2208 fine_mesh = self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
2209 f"mesh_{dig.fine.name}").name
2210 coarse_mesh = self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
2211 f"mesh_{dig.coarse.name}").name
2212 if fine_mesh not in initialised:
2213 initialised.append(fine_mesh)
2214 parent.add(
2215 AssignGen(parent, pointer=True,
2216 lhs=fine_mesh,
2217 rhs="%".join([dig.fine.proxy_name_indexed,
2218 dig.fine.ref_name(),
2219 "get_mesh()"])))
2220 if Config.get().distributed_memory:
2221 max_halo_f_mesh = (
2222 self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
2223 f"max_halo_depth_mesh_{dig.fine.name}").name)
2224
2225 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=max_halo_f_mesh,
2226 rhs=f"{fine_mesh}%get_halo_depth()"))
2227 if coarse_mesh not in initialised:
2228 initialised.append(coarse_mesh)
2229 parent.add(
2230 AssignGen(parent, pointer=True,
2231 lhs=coarse_mesh,
2232 rhs="%".join([dig.coarse.proxy_name_indexed,
2233 dig.coarse.ref_name(),
2234 "get_mesh()"])))
2235 if Config.get().distributed_memory:
2236 max_halo_c_mesh = (
2237 self._schedule.symbol_table.find_or_create_tag(
2238 f"max_halo_depth_mesh_{dig.coarse.name}").name)
2239 parent.add(AssignGen(
2240 parent, lhs=max_halo_c_mesh,
2241 rhs=f"{coarse_mesh}%get_halo_depth()"))
2242 # We also need a pointer to the mesh map which we get from
2243 # the coarse mesh
2244 if dig.mmap not in initialised:
2245 initialised.append(dig.mmap)
2246 parent.add(
2247 AssignGen(parent, pointer=True,
2248 lhs=dig.mmap,
2249 rhs=f"{coarse_mesh}%get_mesh_map({fine_mesh})"))
2250
2251 # Cell map. This is obtained from the mesh map.
2252 if dig.cell_map not in initialised:
2253 initialised.append(dig.cell_map)
2254 parent.add(
2255 AssignGen(parent, pointer=True, lhs=dig.cell_map,
2256 rhs=dig.mmap+"%get_whole_cell_map()"))
2257
2258 # Number of cells in the fine mesh
2259 if dig.ncell_fine not in initialised:
2260 initialised.append(dig.ncell_fine)
2261 if Config.get().distributed_memory:
2262 # TODO this hardwired depth of 2 will need changing in
2263 # order to support redundant computation
2264 parent.add(
2265 AssignGen(parent, lhs=dig.ncell_fine,
2266 rhs=(fine_mesh+"%get_last_halo_cell"
2267 "(depth=2)")))
2268 else:
2269 parent.add(
2270 AssignGen(parent, lhs=dig.ncell_fine,
2271 rhs="%".join([dig.fine.proxy_name,
2272 dig.fine.ref_name(),
2273 "get_ncell()"])))
2274
2275 # Number of fine cells per coarse cell in x.
2276 if dig.ncellpercellx not in initialised:
2277 initialised.append(dig.ncellpercellx)
2278 parent.add(
2279 AssignGen(parent, lhs=dig.ncellpercellx,
2280 rhs=dig.mmap +
2281 "%get_ntarget_cells_per_source_x()"))
2282
2283 # Number of fine cells per coarse cell in y.
2284 if dig.ncellpercelly not in initialised:
2285 initialised.append(dig.ncellpercelly)
2286 parent.add(
2287 AssignGen(parent, lhs=dig.ncellpercelly,
2288 rhs=dig.mmap +
2289 "%get_ntarget_cells_per_source_y()"))
2290
2291 # Colour map for the coarse mesh (if required)
2292 if dig.colourmap_symbol:
2293 # Number of colours
2294 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=dig.ncolours_var_symbol.name,
2295 rhs=coarse_mesh + "%get_ncolours()"))
2296 # Colour map itself
2297 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=dig.colourmap_symbol.name,
2298 pointer=True,
2299 rhs=coarse_mesh + "%get_colour_map()"))
2300 # Last halo/edge cell per colour.
2301 sym = dig.last_cell_var_symbol
2302 if len(sym.datatype.shape) == 2:
2303 # Array is 2D so is a halo access.
2304 name = "%get_last_halo_cell_all_colours()"
2305 else:
2306 # Array is just 1D so go to the last edge cell.
2307 name = "%get_last_edge_cell_all_colours()"
2308 parent.add(AssignGen(parent, lhs=sym.name,
2309 rhs=coarse_mesh + name))
2310
2311 @property
2312 def intergrid_kernels(self):
2313 '''
2314 :returns: A list of objects describing the intergrid kernels used in
2315 this invoke.
2316 :rtype: list[:py:class:`psyclone.dynamo3p0.DynInterGrid`]
2317 '''
2318 intergrids = []
2319 for call in self._schedule.coded_kernels():
2320 if call.is_intergrid:
2321 intergrids.append(call._intergrid_ref)
2322 return intergrids
2323
2324
2325class DynInterGrid():
2326 '''
2327 Holds information on quantities required by an inter-grid kernel.
2328
2329 :param fine_arg: Kernel argument on the fine mesh.
2330 :type fine_arg: :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.DynKernelArgument`
2331 :param coarse_arg: Kernel argument on the coarse mesh.
2332 :type coarse_arg: :py:class:`psyclone.dynamo0p3.DynKernelArgument`
2333 '''
2334 # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods, too-many-instance-attributes
2335 def __init__(self, fine_arg, coarse_arg):
2336
2337 # Arguments on the coarse and fine grids
2338 self.coarse = coarse_arg
2339 self.fine = fine_arg
2340
2341 # Get a reference to the InvokeSchedule SymbolTable
2342 symtab = self.coarse.call.ancestor(InvokeSchedule).symbol_table
2343
2344 # Generate name for inter-mesh map
2345 base_mmap_name = f"mmap_{fine_arg.name}_{coarse_arg.name}"
2346 self.mmap = symtab.find_or_create_tag(base_mmap_name).name
2347
2348 # Generate name for ncell variables
2349 name = f"ncell_{fine_arg.name}"
2350 self.ncell_fine = symtab.find_or_create_integer_symbol(
2351 name, tag=name).name
2352 # No. of fine cells per coarse cell in x
